purpose: Execute the still-unobserved Stage D fixture and power block through the byte-identical v4.7 scientific runner after moving every uv and XDG runtime path beneath the writable repository and positively probing every absolute runtime path.

history.justification: Both v4.7 deployments terminated before the production loader and before any model request because the provider mounted /workspace as root-owned. The failures produced no fixture, power, or scientific information. v4.8 is a distinct environment-only successor under the user-approved outcome-independent repair policy; it does not restart v4.7.

can_establish: every absolute runtime path required before a model request is writable by the unprivileged launch user
the exact v4.7 fixed initialization yields enough exact fixed-topology, reward-informative child-output targets to justify a separately preregistered scientific campaign
cannot_establish: an end-to-end Stage D reward improvement

scientific_inheritance.policy: byte-identical through the inherited v4.7 runner
scientific_inheritance.joint_pass_rule: at least 58 of 64 unique papers are both eligible and informative
unchanged_fields: fixture and power addresses and seeds

runtime.probe_contract: Before invoking the inherited runner, create and remove a unique directory as ubuntu inside every exact directory, write/read/truncate the exact evidence context file, require at least 45 GiB free on both /workspace/redco and /tmp, and retain the tabular report.
runtime.root_owned_bootstrap: The wrapper may use noninteractive sudo only to create and chown /workspace/models, /workspace/.cache, and /workspace/.cache/huggingface and to install an empty ubuntu-owned /workspace/evidence_context.txt before the unprivileged probes.

request_boundaries.fixture: The inherited runner writes FIXTURE_REQUESTS_STARTED immediately before its first live fixture command.
request_boundaries.power: The inherited runner writes POWER_REQUESTS_STARTED immediately before its first live power command.
request_boundaries.address_reuse_justification: Every v4.7 request count is cryptographically recorded as zero; no fixture or power output exists.

repair_policy.eligible_boundary: Only a demonstrated outcome-independent environment or deployment failure before the first fixture request.
required_before_redeployment: terminate the pod and confirm zero persistent disks
record exact billing and failure evidence
commit a bounded repair that changes no scientific field
repair_policy.after_fixture_request_started: terminal for the fixture address; no silent retry or same-address reuse
repair_policy.after_power_request_started: terminal for the power block; no silent retry or same-address reuse

budget.hardware_amendment_rule: rate_usd_per_hour * authorized_timeout_seconds / 3600 + cumulative_v4_8_spend_usd must be no greater than cumulative_v4_8_cap_usd
budget.redeployment_budget_rule: the repair inherits the depleted cumulative cap; it never resets

hardware.selection: cheapest genuinely available qualifying resource after a committed hardware-only amendment
hardware.pods: at most one; resume a single exact v4.8 pod rather than create a duplicate
hardware.ssh: verify noninteractively with C:/Users/mihir/.ssh/id_rsa before sync or model work

authorization.fixture_and_power_model_calls: authorized only after every frozen preflight passes
authorization.next_if_power_passes: terminate support compute, recover and verify artifacts, then separately freeze and adversarially audit the three-arm scientific campaign before any scientific model call
authorization.next_if_power_fails: stop Stage D initialization engineering as already preregistered

always_local: all inherited v4.7 fixture and power artifacts
artifact_policy.retained_model_artifact: the already-local compressed step-8 adapter only
artifact_policy.teardown: always terminate compute and confirm zero persistent disks
